waypoints.title: Sgr B2 Deep South
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam: red = F480M-F410M, green = F405N-F410M, blue = F187N-F182M. We visit three fields in Sgr B2 Deep South, each a few arcseconds across, switching between JWST and ALMA on identical sky. White contours are ALMA SiO J=5-4 (217.105 GHz): SiO is released when outflows shock the gas, so the contours show the outflows, tracing back to their origin at the ALMA continuum sources - which are offset from the JWST F480M emission.

waypoints.title: Field 1 - JWST
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam: red = F480M-F410M, green = F405N-F410M, blue = F187N-F182M. 5.5 arcsec across; the red 4.8 micron excess traces warm dust and shocked gas. White contours are ALMA SiO J=5-4 (217.105 GHz): SiO is released when outflows shock the gas, so the contours show the outflows, tracing back to their origin at the ALMA continuum sources - which are offset from the JWST F480M emission.

waypoints.title: Field 1 - ALMA
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam: red = F480M-F410M, green = F405N-F410M, blue = F187N-F182M. The same 5.5 arcsec in ALMA 1.3 mm continuum at 0.15 arcsec resolution. The SiO contours hold as a spatial reference, then fade: the millimeter sources sit at the outflow origins, beside rather than on the infrared knots.

waypoints.title: Field 2 - JWST
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam: red = F480M-F410M, green = F405N-F410M, blue = F187N-F182M. 6.4 arcsec across. A bright star with strong diffraction spikes sits beside the outflow. White contours are ALMA SiO J=5-4 (217.105 GHz): SiO is released when outflows shock the gas, so the contours show the outflows, tracing back to their origin at the ALMA continuum sources - which are offset from the JWST F480M emission.

waypoints.title: Field 2 - ALMA
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam: red = F480M-F410M, green = F405N-F410M, blue = F187N-F182M. In the millimeter the bright infrared star vanishes and one compact source lights up at the SiO origin: a protostar still inside its envelope, driving the outflow the contours trace.

waypoints.title: Field 3 - JWST
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam: red = F480M-F410M, green = F405N-F410M, blue = F187N-F182M. 9 arcsec across, further south: fainter, more extended, with an SiO ridge running north-south through the field. White contours are ALMA SiO J=5-4 (217.105 GHz): SiO is released when outflows shock the gas, so the contours show the outflows, tracing back to their origin at the ALMA continuum sources - which are offset from the JWST F480M emission.

waypoints.title: Field 3 - ALMA
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam: red = F480M-F410M, green = F405N-F410M, blue = F187N-F182M. A chain of compact millimeter sources runs along that ridge - protostars in a filament nearly invisible in the infrared, each shocking the gas around it into SiO emission.

waypoints.title: Back Out
waypoints.description: JWST NIRCam: red = F480M-F410M, green = F405N-F410M, blue = F187N-F182M. Three fields, 5 to 9 arcsec each, out of a cloud spanning arcminutes. Star formation in Deep South runs along filaments rather than concentrating in the classic cores.
